title: Report of the Secretary of State of the State of Indiana for the year ending October 31, 1880: vote for congressmen, October election, 1880

offices.house: Representatives in Congress, one table per district (several per page), counties down, columns by candidate

note: Leaves are Internet Archive page indexes (printed pages 101 to 107). The congressional election was held October 12, 1880; the archive dates these contests 1880-11-02. The president and governor are on a fold-out sheet (leaves 136-137) that is not specced here.
